description: Owner or Admin: connect GitHub once for this workspace. Give authorization_url to the customer and repeat identical arguments and key to observe completion. One connection covers subsequent source_link calls; no provider token is returned. Failed or expired attempts require a fresh key for this same workspace, never a new project.

profile_name.description: Saved login to act as (profile_list shows them). Needed only when several logins could run this call; OHMYHOST_PROFILE of this server must match it.

name: github_connect
